steps.say: For a question on growth in Uganda in FY25, the search returns three passages.
steps.speak: For a question on growth in Uganda in F Y twenty-five, the search returns three passages.

steps.say: The December 2025 report gives 6.3 percent for the full year.
steps.speak: The December twenty twenty-five report gives six point three percent for the full year.

steps.say: The September 2025 report gives 6.8 percent for the first nine months.
steps.speak: The September twenty twenty-five report gives six point eight percent for the first nine months.

steps.say: A table in the June 2023 report gives 6.7 percent as a projection, made before the year began.
steps.speak: A table in the June twenty twenty-three report gives six point seven percent as a projection, made before the year began.

steps.say: The application puts the three passages into the prompt, under the instructions.
The instructions tell the model to answer only from the passages, and to cite a passage after each figure.
They also tell the model to say so when the passages do not contain what is needed.
The model answers with 6.3 percent, the full-year figure, and cites the December 2025 report.
steps.speak: The model answers with six point three percent, the full-year figure, and cites the December twenty twenty-five report.

steps.say: It reports the figure for nine months as a partial year.
It leaves out the projection from 2023 and states the reason.
steps.speak: It leaves out the projection from twenty twenty-three and states the reason.

steps.say: Each citation names a report and a page. Page 12 of the December 2025 report holds the full-year figure.
steps.speak: Each citation names a report and a page. Page twelve of the December twenty twenty-five report holds the full-year figure.

steps.say: Page 40 of the June 2023 report holds the projection, in a table of forecasts.
steps.speak: Page forty of the June twenty twenty-three report holds the projection, in a table of forecasts.

steps.say: A reader can see when each figure was published before using it.
